fields.objection: W and L axisymmetric surrogates rotate material directions around the pole and omit general nonaxisymmetric modes and panel/seam geometry.
fields.proposed_fix: Run a converged 3D model of the actual core orientation, seams, defects and supports. Do not call the two surrogates universal bounds.
